name: Luke Lay
title: Broadcast Engineer
bio: Luke is a skilled broadcast engineer and live events professional who is as comfortable behind a console as he is managing complex video infrastructure. With deep expertise in Disguise, Analog Way, and Barco systems, he has delivered broadcast-quality results on some of the industry's most technically demanding productions — and judging by the photo, he brings that same focused energy everywhere he goes.

projects.title: Broadcast Productions
projects.desc: Broadcast engineering for large-scale live productions, managing Analog Way and Barco systems with precision and reliability from pre-production through show day.

projects.title: Corporate Events
projects.desc: Technical lead for high-profile corporate productions requiring broadcast-quality video output, multi-screen setups, and real-time content management.

projects.title: Touring & Festival Shows
projects.desc: Broadcast engineer on major touring and festival productions, adapting video and broadcast workflows across venues of all sizes nightly.

projects.title: Live Streaming
projects.desc: Technical director for live streaming productions, managing end-to-end video workflows and ensuring broadcast-quality delivery for global online audiences.
